name: triz
description: TRIZ for engineering trade-offs, at two depths in one skill. The short route: state the problem as a contradiction, map it to Altshuller's 39 engineering parameters, read the classic contradiction matrix for the inventive principles it recommends, and adapt them to the system at hand; a physical contradiction goes to the separation principles instead. The long route, for a problem the short one did not crack: ARIZ-85C, Altshuller's nine-part algorithm, walked step by step with the user. The matrix ships as a plain-text reference the agent reads with a search over one line per cell; the parameters, principles and ARIZ steps are references beside it, each with its provenance. No script, no dependency, no network, no credentials.
